details: Installed Herder advertises only codex; no OpenCode server or credential configured. Current Codex config has no Ollama/Gemma provider; an explicit create_session for OpenCode returned INVALID_ARGUMENT. Candidate isolated journey passes but installed process cannot safely route to local fake/Gemma without verified configuration. User explicitly forbids inventing a separate addressed test route and access changes.
